observed_failure.message: length termination must reach max_new_tokens exactly
observed_failure.location: abi/hf_extraction.py source generation evidence to abi/layercake_acquisition.py record validation

root_cause.explanation: The recorder inspected only tokenizer.eos_token_id. Phi-3 generation may stop on model-configured ID 32001 or 32007, so a completed short batch row was incorrectly labeled as a length stop. The downstream accounting validator rejected the inconsistent short length-terminated row exactly as designed.

recovery_boundary: Use the union of immutable model generation-config, model-config, and tokenizer EOS IDs. Do not weaken the length-termination rejection or alter the catalog, source, GPU, thresholds, or output path.
